title: Cuiji single dish ZIP manifest v1

title.description: Trimmed nonempty title; at most 200 Swift extended grapheme clusters.

text.description: Plain UTF-8, at most 100000 bytes; keep newlines.

sourceURL.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL with host, without credentials; max 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

items.description: No '..'; max 160 UTF-8 bytes. Extensions are case insensitive.

description: Requires text, image or source beyond title. Runtime enforces byte limits, safe paths, image decoding and exact ZIP entries. Additive fields retain their JSON structure and types. Missing text/images default to empty; established field names, types, hierarchy and version are fixed.
